For a Jodhpur handicrafts exporter, I’d shortlist:

Option	Best for	Watch-outs
DHL Express	Reliable, fast B2C/B2B exports	Premium base rates; volumetric weight
FedEx	Regular exporters/account rates	Fuel + demand surcharges; clearance fees
UPS	Larger/heavier parcels	Remote-area, fuel and brokerage charges

DHL, FedEx and UPS all calculate charges beyond the headline freight rate; DHL/FedEx also apply volumetric-weight rules. 
DHL
+2
FedEx
+2

Hidden fees to check:

Fuel surcharge

Remote/extended-area surcharge

Volumetric-weight adjustment

Customs clearance/brokerage

Duties/GST at destination

Insurance/declared-value fees

Address correction/return-to-origin

Oversize/non-conveyable handling

Peak/demand surcharge

For example, UPS currently lists a ₹2,288 pre-release notification fee and ₹3,660 paper-invoice surcharge in India. 
UPS

My pick: DHL for premium reliability; negotiate account rates if shipping 20+ parcels/month.
